description: On the table in front of you are a green plastic cup, a blue plastic cup, and a small yellow squeeze bottle, with a blue sponge cloth nearby. The left hand and right hand first steady the green cup and sponge cloth together, then the left hand sets the green cup down while the right hand brings the blue cup closer; the right hand picks up the yellow bottle and tips it over the blue cup as if dispensing soap, then sets the bottle back, and finally the right hand presses the blue sponge cloth into the blue cup while the left hand holds the cup steady, scrubbing inside.
